description: CloudWatch Security Metric-Filter Alerting Is Missing or Not Recognized
rationale: The selected Region has a complete read-only inventory of CloudWatch metric alarms and Logs metric filters but has no metric filters, no metric alarms with actions, or no recognized CloudTrail security event metric-filter patterns. Exact-pattern checks may miss equivalent syntactic forms. This assesses CloudWatch metric-filter based alerting only; external SIEM, EventBridge and centralized organization monitoring may provide equivalent coverage and require separate verification.
remediation: Configure or demonstrate equivalent monitoring for unauthorized API calls, root-account activity and security control changes. Validate end-to-end notification delivery. If using external SIEM, EventBridge or a centralized account, record evidence and document the exception.
